children: EQT Corp. (EQT) filed a Form 8K - Regulation FD Disclosure - with the U.S Securities and Exchange Commission on October 26, 2026.
On October 26, 2026, EQT and Range issued a joint news release relating to the Merger, a copy of which is furnished herewith as Exhibit 99.1 and is incorporated herein by reference.

The information furnished in this Item 7.01, including the accompanying Exhibit 99.1, shall not be deemed "filed" for purposes of Section 18 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended (the "Exchange Act"), or otherwise subject to the liabilities of such section, nor shall such information be deemed incorporated by reference into any filing made by EQT under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended (the "Securities Act"), or the Exchange Act, regardless of the general incorporation language of such filing, except as expressly set forth by specific reference in such filing.
The full text of this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/33213/000121390026112242/ea0309601-8k425_eqtcorp.htm
Any exhibits and associated documents for this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/33213/000121390026112242/0001213900-26-112242-index.htm
Public companies must file a Form 8-K, or current report, with the SEC generally within four days of any event that could materially affect a company's financial position or the value of its shares.
